versions.changelog:
- Added a link to more Dreamface AI tools in the Quick Start section.
- Clarified local file upload instructions (get upload policy, then upload).
- Removed redundant and detailed steps for the upload policy and upload process.
- No changes to API usage or parameters.

Initial release of dream-image-to-video.

- Generate 4-second videos from text prompts and images using the Image to Video (Wan2.1) API.
- Supports prompt descriptions up to 1500 characters and images via URL.
- Offers output video resolution options: 480p (default) and 720p.
- Guides for configuring API keys and uploading local files included.
- Integration powered by Dreamface—visit https://tools.dreamfaceapp.com/home for more AI tools.
